title: Operational Risk Senior Specialist
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Operational Risk Specialist, plays a vital role within the operational risk management function at Nu Mexico. The main duties involve identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating operational risks that may hinder the company from reaching its objectives. This is accomplished by developing methodologies and ensuring their implementation and execution within the first line of defense. This process includes training, review and challenge, monitoring key risk indicators, and escalating issues in appropriate Risk Forums. This role involves close collaboration with different departments and teams to execute various Operational Risk programs aimed at reducing and controlling the likelihood and impact of adverse operational risk events.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

1. Lead the oversight and continuous improvement of the Op Risk Management System, ensuring that policies, methodologies, procedures, governance practices, and supporting documentation remain aligned with local regulation and global standards.

2. Lead and coordinate the annual and continuous RCSA process, maintaining high-quality risk and control matrices by ensuring that operational risks are properly identified, documented, classified, assigned to processes and business lines, and linked to accountable owners and controls.

3. Perform independent 2LoD review and challenge of 1LoD risk assessments and controls, including the evaluation of inherent risk, residual risk, control design, control execution, supporting evidence, and overall control effectiveness.

4. Own the governance and periodic maintenance of risk matrices across macroprocesses, ensuring that changes in products, processes, regulations, systems, incidents, control gaps, and organizational priorities are properly reflected, documented, and traceable in the institutional risk inventory.

5. Assess complex operational risks and define appropriate treatment strategies based on inherent and residual risk exposure, risk appetite, and tolerance thresholds, including mitigation plans, risk transfers, formal risk acceptances, and escalation of risks outside tolerance.

6. Monitor operational loss events, incidents, and control gaps; lead or support root cause analysis; ensure accurate and timely registration; and define corrective, preventive, and improvement actions to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.

7. Design, manage, and enhance the Key Risk Indicator program for priority operational risks, ensuring that each applicable risk in the RCM has measurable indicators, defined amber and red thresholds, reliable data sources, periodic monitoring, documented analysis, and appropriate escalation.

8. Evaluate operational risks associated with new products, features, processes, operational changes, and other initiatives, ensuring that potential control gaps are identified, mitigation plans are defined, and required actions are completed before launch or formal implementation.

9. Prepare and present accurate, well-structured risk reports, dashboards, and management materials for senior leadership, the Non-Financial Risk Technical Forum, the Risk Committee, and other governance bodies

title: Marketing Assistant (Brand & Organic Marketing)
description:
Description
TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.
About the role

﻿
Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.
You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.
What you will do

• Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.

• Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages-a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.

• Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.

• The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.

• The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

• Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.

• Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.

• A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.

• B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.

• Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

• Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.

• Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

• Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).

• Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.

• Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.

• A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

Disclosures:
This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.
TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

description:
Geometry with consequences. Deep learning on 3D CAD data where correctness translates into steel and aluminum, not pixels.
The ultimate tinkerer's playground. Physical machines, shop floors, and modern cloud architectures all in one stack.
Tangible impact. Your work feeds the data pipelines that power our AI quoting and calculation engines. Factories operate differently because of what you ship.
High autonomy. A fragmented industry full of unsolved problems, and the freedom to prototype, test, and deploy your own solutions end-to-end.
What you'll do:

• Develop advanced feature-extraction and data-processing solutions for 3D CAD, 2D, and batch data feeding our machine learning systems.

• Build, train, and industrialize deep learning models that understand geometry and drive our quoting, calculation, and optimization engines.

• Enhance and extend our 2D/3D/CAD tools and geometry solutions.

• Design, engineer, and own cloud services, APIs, and automated model training/deployment - from proof of concept to production under real load.

• Go deep across interconnected cloud, data, computer vision, and ML services spanning multiple languages and platforms.

For over 10 years at Imnoo at Imnoo, we are bridging the gap between applied artificial intelligence and heavy industrial machinery.
Imnoo is sustainability focused, creating real value as well as a profitable company with stable base.
We aren't just riding the recent AI wave, we have been deeply rooted in machine learning and statistical analysis for 10 years, delivering real, measurable value to a stable, loyal client base of manufacturers.
Imnoo is a leading SaaS platform built to analyze CNC parts, automate quoting and planning, and seamlessly connect the cloud with real manufacturers and shop-floor machines. We are looking for a unique hybrid (a CAD AI IoT Engineer / Tinkerer) who thrives at the intersection of software architecture and physical hardware. You won't just be writing code behind a desk; you will be the mastermind connecting our battle-tested algorithms directly to the pulse of the factory floor. If you love reverse-engineering industrial protocols, building edge data pipelines, and parsing complex 3D geometry to automate the business of manufacturing, this is your playground.

• Machine learning / deep learning experience. Real development experience or serious projects: building, training, and shipping models (PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, scikit-learn or similar), not just coursework or library calls.

• Strong mathematical understanding. Linear algebra, geometry, statistics, probability. Our problems are mathematical at their core; this is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.

• Strong software engineering. 3+ years across dynamically and statically typed languages (e.g. Python plus C++/C#), with sharp problem-solving skills.

• Computer Graphics / Game development / 3D foundations. Hands-on experience in game development, 3D geometry, rendering, fluid simulations, CUDA/GPU programming, or similar. This is a headline requirement, not a bonus.

• Production experience. You've built or maintained systems running under heavy load.

Nice to have

• CAD system development experience; CNC / mechanical industry exposure.

• ML industrialization: ONNX, quantization, Docker, MLOps practices, automated model training and deployment.

• Large-dataset work: processing, clustering, filtering, indexing, and querying; statistical testing and outlier analysis.

• Cloud services (AWS/Azure), SQL and NoSQL databases, full-stack experience (e.g. Angular).

Long term stability a profitable company can offer
Mix of technologies offering building up experience

title: Director Global Alliance Leader for AI Infrastructure Channels and VARs (Value-Added Resellers)
description:
As Director Global Alliance Leader at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building the channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room. Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in GSIs, ISVs, and distributors where they accelerate a reseller deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP. (Internally titled Director, Alliances, Channel & VARs)

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. There is no channel to inherit and no team underneath you. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.

As Director Global Alliance Leader, Channels and VARs, your role will include:

- Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction (agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, first close) and retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

- Transaction mechanics: You will own the reseller commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record (regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account), and build distribution where it scales the motion while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

- Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers with deal registration the field trusts, and give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

- Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect reseller opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a GSI, ISV, or distributor accelerates a reseller deal, you bring them in.

- Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached (field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, customer stories) and approve MDF against pipeline outcomes with proof of performance enforced. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

- Owning the channel number: MEDDPICC on every partner-attached opportunity. Weekly pipeline inspection. Partner attribution queryable from day one; pipeline we cannot query is pipeline we do not have. QBRs on a fixed cadence with a fixed agenda: bookings against plan, named-account inspection, certification status, marketing execution, renewal health, forward-quarter plan. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs; you report your KPIs without being asked: transacting partners, sourced and attached pipeline and bookings, registration volume and win rate, certified resources, MDF return.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

- Channel leadership with a number behind it: 8+ years in channel, reseller, or partner sales in infrastructure software, AI

title: Senior Oracle EBS Developer / Integration Architect
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.
We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.
CompassX is partnering with an enterprise client to support a fast-moving AI-driven initiative connecting their Oracle E-Business Suite environment to a broader integration and applications ecosystem. This is a chance to work at the architecture and development level on a genuinely complex problem for an organization that's investing seriously in modernizing how its core ERP talks to the rest of its new applications and technology stack.
What You'll Do

• Design and build a common data-services layer that connects multiple, differently-configured Oracle EBS instances across regions - reconciling real differences between environments rather than treating them as identical

• Expose EBS data through integrations and APIs to other systems, with a particular focus on Manufacturing, Inventory, and Item Master data

• Work hands-on with PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces, and standard APIs - this is a build role, not a configuration role

• Partner directly with other developers and technical stakeholders as a peer - you'll be the one they come to with questions about the SQL and architecture, not someone translating between business and engineering

• Bring an architect's perspective to the work: looking across distinct systems, spotting where approaches diverge, and designing a solution that holds up across all of them rather than solving for just one environment

• Act as a trusted technical voice in a still-evolving initiative - this program is actively taking shape, and there's real room to help define how the work gets scoped and delivered, not just execute against a fixed spec

What You'll Bring

• Strong experience working as a true consultant to your stakeholders and clients

• Deep, hands-on Oracle EBS technical development experience - strong PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces and standard APIs, and concurrent program load mechanisms

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and/or SOA, plus REST/SOAP web services

• Working knowledge of EBS data models for Manufacturing/BOM, Inventory, and Item Master - direct experience with the Item/PTM table is especially valuable

• Experience working across multiple EBS instances, ideally having reconciled differently-configured environments

• A technical/integration mindset over a functional/configuration one - comfortable going deep on code and architecture, not just gathering requirements

• Comfort operating with some ambiguity - this is an early-stage initiative, and part of the value you bring is helping shape the approach alongside the team, not just following one that's already fully defined

• Bonus if familiarity with Oracle PD Cloud (Oracle PLM)

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.
With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

title: AI Data Intelligence & Knowledge Graph Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an AI Data Intelligence & Knowledge Graph Engineer to lead a distributed organization of AI/ML, NLP, knowledge graph, and data intelligence professionals in the United States and/or Prague. This leader will be responsible for building and scaling the team, setting technical direction, and delivering production-grade capabilities that transform unstructured and structured enterprise data into accurate, contextual, governed, and AI-ready information.

The role sits at the intersection of applied AI, machine learning, document intelligence, semantic modeling, and enterprise data management. You will guide teams working on knowledge graph construction, ontology and taxonomy development, entity and relationship extraction, document classification, retrieval, model optimization, and AI-assisted workflows. You will also establish the operating mechanisms, quality bar, and cross-functional partnerships needed to move these capabilities from research and experimentation into reliable enterprise products.

This is a hands-on people leadership role for a technically credible manager who can operate across geographies, connect strategy to execution, and develop strong leaders and senior individual contributors. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing model quality, graph architecture, production reliability, talent strategy, and customer outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead and develop a geographically distributed team in the United States and Prague, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and organizational design.

• Establish a clear team strategy and roadmap for AI data intelligence, knowledge graph capabilities, document intelligence, and AI-ready data workflows.

• Partner with senior leaders in Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, Security, Quality, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market to align priorities and deliver measurable outcomes.

• Guide the design and implementation of production systems that extract entities and relationships, classify and enrich data, build semantic context, and make information useful for AI models, agents, and enterprise applications.

• Lead technical direction across knowledge graph and semantic technologies, including ontology and taxonomy design, entity resolution, graph analytics, graph-based retrieval, and GraphRAG patterns.

• Oversee AI/ML approaches for document intelligence, named entity recognition, information retrieval, classification, embeddings, LLM-assisted workflows, and domain-specific extraction.

• Create a disciplined model and data lifecycle covering dataset generation, annotation, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and governance.

• Establish quality and reliability standards using measures such as precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, retrieval effectiveness, false-positive and false-negative rates, drift, and customer-reported outcomes.

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Complaint Management Specialist for Vinted Pay, you will be the guardian of our users' trust and our regulatory compliance. You will investigate, resolve, and formally respond to complex, escalated payment complaints-turning challenging situations into positive user outcomes while ensuring we strictly adhere to financial regulations. The role sits in the Vinted Pay CS organisation, part of the broader Customer Operations team at Vinted, supporting our rapidly expanding and regulated financial services entity (Vinted Pay).

In this position, you’ll 

• Serve as the primary contact for high-priority, complex member complaint cases requiring special handling.

• Create and document tailored solutions for member complaint cases, balancing company policies, regulations and customer satisfaction.

• Resolve complex member issues by collaborating with multiple different internal/external stakeholders.

• Be the voice of our members by translating complex pain points into actionable insights for our Product and Policy teams.

• Act as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, legal, and PR teams.

About you 

• Have experience in customer service/complaint handling

• Able to assess complex issues, identify root causes, and implement creative solutions.

• Have excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain solutions clearly and calmly, even in challenging situations.

• Demonstrate Customer-centric Mindset: Empathy and a commitment to ensuring a positive customer experience.

• Possess high emotional intelligence and the ability to remain objective and resilient when handling sensitive or confrontational situations

• Able to effectively plan and prioritize your tasks

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Work perks 

• The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

• 25 working days of holiday

• Access to all the tools & tech needed for work

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

• Private health insurance

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• Frequent team-building events

About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team builds and scales the systems and data architecture that power OpenAI’s core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, supply chain, financial planning, and asset management. As a Business Systems Lead for Procure-to-Pay, you will be a hands-on engineer who designs, builds, and operates the integrations and first-party applications that power OpenAI’s procurement workflows. You will translate business needs into secure, scalable software, APIs, data flows, and automation across Oracle Fusion, Zip, and connected platforms.

You will build the future of buying at OpenAI using OpenAI’s own technology, from guided intake and approval experiences to supplier onboarding, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and downstream financial data flows. Your core strength will be software and integration engineering. - Own production health and incident resolution, protect access and financial controls, and deliver durable fixes that reduce failed transactions, manual intervention, and procurement cycle time.

Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

The Role

Our Data Engineering & AI team is growing! We’re looking for a Data Architect to join our team in London.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the target architecture for QiCore and act as design authority for every build that lands in it

- Establish clear approaches to customer identity, PII, consent, data classification, retention and access controls, working with relevant security, privacy and governance stakeholders.

- High standards for quality, and the clarity to explain design trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders

- You thrive when working as part of a team

- Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

- Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

title: Inpatient Coding Specialist - Level 1 Trauma
description:
Job Description
UW Medicine Enterprise Records and Health Information has an outstanding opportunity for an INPATIENT CODER . Experience in a Level 1 Trauma center and/or teaching facility is required.

WORK SCHEDULE

• 100% FTE, Days

• Mondays - Fridays

• 100% Remote

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS

• Implements the mission and goals of Enterprise Records and Health Information, and incorporating a “patients are first” service culture.

• Performs daily activities related to of abstract Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) coding and billing

• Analyzes the medical record to assign International Classification of Diseases (ICD), Clinical Modification (CM) diagnoses and Procedure Coding System (PCS) procedure codes to ensure correct code assignment and optimal reimbursement in compliance with state and federal guidelines

DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Enterprise Records and Health Information (ERHI) is a Shared Service Department that supports all aspects of the patient medical record from governance, integrity, documentation timeliness, completion, clinical coding, billing, release, and tracking to management of access, retention, and destruction.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Performs chart analysis and assigns ICD-CM and ICD-PCS codes using 3M computer assisted coding (CAC) to compute the final DRG assignment to diagnoses and procedures in an integrated system to ensure the appropriate coding for the facility inpatient billing and reimbursement

• Reviews patient records upon admission and at discharge to the inpatient Rehabilitation Unit; assigns codes to each record to assure proper Case Mix Group (CMG) assignment and appropriate reimbursement to the facility for Medicare Rehab patients

• Abstracts and/or reviews necessary patient data within EPIC and 3M 360 CAC to ensure data integrity, accurate reimbursement, proper case mix and hospital decision support.

• Identifies the need for documentation clarity and works with the Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) department to review clinical documentation and/or request provider documentation clarification

• Maintains four day turnaround times for inpatient coding based on the discharge date and understand charge lag impacts, especially for high dollar accounts and long length of stays (LOS).

REQUIRED POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent and three years of coding experience or equivalent education/experience.

• Certified as a Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Certified Outpatient Coder (COC), Certified Interventional Radiology Cardiovascular Coder (CIRCC), Radiology Certified Coder (RCC) or Radiation Oncology Certified Coder (ROCC).

UW Medicine - Where your Impact Goes Further
UW Medicine is Washington’s only health system that includes a top-rated medical school and an internationally recognized research center. description:
Director of Product, AI
Toolbx · Product · Full-time · Remote (USA or Canada) · Reports to VP
About Toolbx

Toolbx is a vertical software platform for the lumber and building materials industry, offering dealers and distributors a suite of tools, from AR and payments to eCommerce and AI-powered ordering. We connect dealers, contractors and suppliers through a commerce layer that actually understands how the industry works, job-site deliveries, trade accounts, ERP-native pricing, mobile-first ordering. The industry is mid-transformation, and we’re the team building the rails it runs on.
Our platform is growing fast. 130+ dealers are live across USA and Canada. 1000s of daily transactions are flowing through our platform. The next chapter is about depth, smarter integrations, AI-driven ordering intelligence, and a product surface that earns contractor loyalty at scale.
The Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product who leads from the front. You’ll own the roadmap, the execution, and the outcomes. You’ll also be the person running discovery calls with dealers, prototyping solutions, and going deep on a thorny integration problem when the situation calls for it. But you won’t do it all manually, you’ll design the system that gets it done, using AI agents and automation alongside your team to maximize output. This is a player-coach role with a builder’s mindset. We have no need for a professional manager.
You’ll report directly to the VP, Strategy & Partnerships and manage a small product team, working alongside a tight-knit cross-functional group spanning engineering, customer success, design, and commercial. You’ll be measured on product velocity and outcomes, not headcount.
What You’ll Own
Product roadmap & platform strategy
Define and drive the roadmap across Toolbx ’s core platform, ordering, payments, catalog, integrations, and AI capabilities. Translate market signals, dealer feedback, and internal data into a sequenced plan that balances near-term wins with durable platform value.
Hands-on execution
Lead discovery, prototype solutions, and ship features from concept to launch. You’re not above digging into an edge case in a supported ERP or jumping on a call with a dealer’s IT team. You also know which parts of the product development cycle can be automated and you build those systems. Your team looks to you to model what great product work looks like in an AI-native company. Travelling to meet customers face to face is expected.
AI product development
Own the product surface for Toolbx ’s AI-powered ordering automation (AIOA). This is live, it’s differentiating, and it needs a product leader who can take it from early-stage to a core reason dealers choose Toolbx over anyone else.
Integration & ecosystem depth
You’ll own the platform to ERP integration strategy across our dealer ecosystem. Epicor BisTrack, Epicor Eagle, ECI Spruce, DMSI Agility are core supported ERPs. Knowing where to build, where to partner, and where to hold the line is a required skill here.
Team leadership
Manage and develop a team of 2-3 PMs, from near-peer senior level Group Product Managers to early career Associate Product Managers. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and create the conditions for excellent work. Hire well. Coach constantly. Raise the bar on craft without creating bureaucracy.
Cross-functional alignment
Partner closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Design to drive execution. Be the person who keeps commercial, technical, and customer perspectives in the same room - and makes a decision when they’re in tension.
Product operations & AI workflows
Design and maintain the operating system for how product work gets done. Build agent-assisted workflows for feature request triage, competitive monitoring, status reporting, and roadmap communication. title: CMO with Legal Experience - United States
description:
Is your love for leading a company based on the market dynamics coming into conflict with the realization that you are tired of working for giant companies? Would you love the idea of hands on working as part of the management team of 2 or 3 companies at once, supported by 125 other world class fractional executives? If you have held the position of VP of Marketing or CMO at one or more large Operating Companies, but don’t want to go back and do it again, you may be a fit for what we do. Chief Outsiders , www.ChiefOutsiders.com, is a national company that is growing very quickly and is looking to add CMOs in multiple US markets.
What We Do: Our focus is on helping midsize companies grow via implementing major growth initiatives in strategy, marketing and business management in a way that will continue to drive top-line growth long after we are gone.
What We Look For: We are looking for C-level operating executives who approach business from a market-based perspective. You must have held the position of VP of Marketing or CMO at one or more large operating companies. We are looking for people who have the experience to help a CEO or business owner understand where and how to grow and then determine which marketing tools to apply to make big things happen.

To succeed you need to be able to help the CEO and leadership team understand what the real business problems are and then develop and implement a plan that fits the company, opportunity and competitive situation.
Compensation: This is not an “eat what you kill” environment, but we use a revenue share compensation model. You are paid a percentage of the billings for the projects that you work on. You get a bigger share of the revenue if you bring in the lead, but there are company funded programs to help you bring in leads. Most of our CMOs target taking home over $200,000 a year, with some making double that amount.

We are currently seeking a Digital Partner Development Manager based in Japan to support partner ecosystem through partner enablement, business development, pipeline growth, and sales acceleration initiatives.
This is a fully remote opportunity for a commercially driven professional who enjoys building strong partner relationships, driving revenue growth, and helping technology partners succeed.
Position Summary
The Digital Partner Development Program Manager will provide pre-sales and post-sales support to assigned partners through a Digital Sales framework. The role is responsible for driving revenue growth, pipeline development, partner readiness, and business performance while serving as a trusted advisor to partners across Japan.
The successful candidate will work closely with partners to increase product adoption, accelerate deal progression, improve partner capabilities, and support business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage assigned partner accounts and maintain regular engagement.

• Build trusted advisor relationships with partner executives and key stakeholders.

• Drive monthly revenue and unit targets through partner engagement and sales support activities.

• Provide sales and business development guidance to identify growth opportunities.

• Develop strategic account plans aligned with partner and business objectives.

• Support partner readiness for Microsoft products, licensing, incentives, programs, and training.

• Deliver consistent pre-sales and post-sales support to assigned partners.

• Act as a subject matter expert on Microsoft tools, programs, and processes.

• Assist partners in solution readiness for Microsoft offerings, including AI solutions, Copilot, and related technologies.

• Accelerate sales through active pipeline management, deal progression, forecasting, and marketing initiatives.

• Conduct partner performance reviews and recommend actions to improve growth and profitability.

• Guide partners through available resources, incentives, and business programs.

• Monitor market trends and provide strategic recommendations to partners.

• Compare and position Microsoft solutions against competing technologies.

• Train partner stakeholders on tools, operational processes, and self-service resources.

• Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, opportunities, and activities within CRM systems.

• Escalate issues and help resolve technical or business roadblocks impacting partner success.

title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do
